name: Hilbert Curve Volume Mapping
definition: A technique to map 1D sequential data (similarity scores) into a 3D volume grid using a space-filling Hilbert curve to maximize spatial coherence, ensuring that neighboring positions in the 1D sequence are adjacent in 3D space.
summary: Hilbert Curve Volume Mapping maps 1D data into a 3D grid using a space-filling curve to maximize spatial coherence, ensuring neighboring 1D positions remain adjacent in 3D space unlike naive scan-line traversal.
